name: Dux Herdr Fleet
description: Multi-machine and workspace agent monitor for herdr and optional Herdr Desktop App (hc/herdr-app) with live status filters, search, context tokens, machine filter, clickable notifications, and cross-machine pane focus. Switching the herdr window to another machine drives herdr's Go to picker through kitty remote control (needs listen_on); an opt-in setting can use a Wayland virtual keyboard instead. Compositor window focus is Niri-only. Fork of Mor-dev/herdr-agent-monitor.
author: arqueon
